why: Some templates put a compact 'Unsubscribe' in the masthead. Cutting at the FIRST occurrence anywhere would reduce this newsletter to its header — which looks ingested-and-empty rather than failed. The cut is bounded to the tail, so the body survives and the real footer still goes.
title: Two things happened in payments this week
